title: JUNK!....BUYER BEWARE!
text: JUNK!....BUYER BEWARE!. After only a few weeks the printing rubs off!

product_metadata.title: Progressive International Butter Keeper, One Size, Clear
features: White and blue base with clear airtight lid
Wide design holds narrow, short, and wide sticks
description: The Prep Solutions by Progressive Butter Keeper features measurement markings for both short and long sticks of butter up to 8 Tbsp. The seal keeps butter fresh and reduces odor absorption. The outside edge of the lid doubles to stamp measurements on butter. This Butter Keeper can be used both in and out of the fridge. It is BPA-free and Dishwasher Safe for easy, convenient cleaning.
